name: hyperliquid_spot-mcp
description: Hyperliquid Spot (public info) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_balances, list_orders. E

platform_mcp_hyperliquid_spot_wallet_add.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HYPERLIQUID_SPOT_WALLET_ADDRESS
platform_mcp_hyperliquid_spot_wallet_add.description: Public 0x address (42 hex characters) of the MAIN wallet whose orders/balances to read. Not a secret; no private key is needed or accepted. Only list_orders/get_balances use it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public info endpoint, no credentials: the probe posts {"type": "spotMeta"} (weight 20).

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Spot pairs in one response (`query` is not sent). Canonical pairs are named like PURR/USDC; others are @<index> (e.g. @107), which is also the coin name get_ticker expects. `raw.tokens` holds token indices, resolved in spotMeta.tokens.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Top of the spot L2 book (weight 2); `symbol` is PURR/USDC or @<index>. No last price or 24h volume per symbol (spotMetaAndAssetCtxs is a positional array).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Open orders of the configured wallet (perp and spot alike; spot coins appear as PURR/USDC or @<index>); `side` is B (buy) or A (sell).
